inc_cause_too_much_throttle: Too much throttle on corner exit (power oversteer)
inc_cause_braking_instability: Braking too hard or too late with steering applied (rear instability)
inc_cause_too_much_steering: Too much or too abrupt steering
inc_cause_overcorrection: Over-correction (the car snapped back the other way)
inc_cause_low_grip: Less grip than usual (tyres, surface or line)
inc_cause_kerb_or_bump: Kerb or bump unsettled the car
inc_cause_downshift: Downshift without blipping / engine braking on the rear axle
inc_cause_understeer_off: Understeer: the front tyres ran out of grip
inc_advice_too_much_throttle: Open the throttle progressively and later, once the steering is unwinding. Consider a higher TC level, a stiffer rear differential or more rear grip in the setup.
inc_advice_lift_off: Do not lift abruptly in the middle of a corner: ease off progressively or stay committed to the throttle. Lifting moves load to the front and unloads the rear.
inc_advice_braking_instability: Finish braking before turning in and release the brake progressively while turning (trail braking). If the rear locks, move the brake bias forward.
inc_advice_too_much_steering: Turn in more gently and look for the point where the car stops asking for more steering. If it already understeers, reduce speed instead of adding lock.
inc_advice_late_correction: Counter-steer as soon as the rear steps out and keep your hands quick: look where you want the car to go. A delayed correction turns a slide into a spin.
inc_advice_overcorrection: Match the counter-steer to the slide and unwind it as the car straightens; large inputs swing the rear the other way.
inc_advice_entry_too_fast: You arrived faster than on your other laps. Brake earlier or harder to reach the usual entry speed.
inc_advice_low_grip: Warm the tyres before pushing, keep the car on the racing line (rubbered surface) and avoid dirty or off-line areas; reduce the attack until the tyres are in their window.
inc_advice_kerb_or_bump: Avoid aggressive kerbs on that corner, or soften the suspension / raise the ride height if the car gets unsettled over bumps.
inc_advice_downshift: Downshift earlier and more smoothly (or blip the throttle) so the rear axle is not locked by engine braking.
inc_advice_wind: Wind is only an additional factor: expect less stability in fast sections when it is strong.
inc_advice_understeer_off: The car did not turn: brake a bit earlier, turn in later and avoid adding steering when the front is already sliding.
inc_ev_throttle_on: Throttle at the start of the loss: {pct}%
inc_ev_throttle_rising: The throttle was rising ({delta} points in the last 0.7 s)
inc_ev_throttle_vs_ref: Throttle {pct}% vs {ref}% on your other laps at this point
inc_ev_rear_slip: Rear tyres slid more than the front ({rear}° vs {front}°)
inc_ev_lift: Throttle dropped {drop} points in under 0.6 s just before
inc_ev_latg: Lateral load at that moment: {g} g
inc_ev_rear_lock: Rear wheels turned at {ratio}% of the front ones (rear lock)
inc_ev_brake_vs_ref: Peak brake {pct}% vs {ref}% on your other laps
inc_ev_steer_vs_ref: Steering {deg}° vs {ref}° on your other laps at this corner
inc_ev_no_countersteer: No counter-steer in the first 0.45 s
inc_ev_countersteer_lag: Counter-steer started {s} s after the car stepped out
inc_ev_small_countersteer: Counter-steer of only {deg}° before the car rotated
inc_ev_pendulum: The slide changed direction after the correction
inc_ev_speed_vs_ref: Entry speed {kmh} km/h vs {ref} km/h on your other laps (+{diff})
inc_ev_early_lap: Early or slow lap with tyres still warming up
inc_ev_dirty_tyres: Tyres carried dirt (level {lvl}) from an earlier excursion
inc_ev_less_latg: Lateral g {g} vs {ref} g you reach here on other laps
inc_ev_downshift: Downshift from {a} to {b} just before, without braking
inc_ev_wind: Wind {kmh} km/h at {speed} km/h (its direction relative to the car is not logged)
inc_ev_front_slip: Front tyres slid more than the rear ({front}° vs {rear}°)
inc_ev_grip_limit: You were already at the grip limit ({g} g vs {ref} g)
